_fixture.purpose: Deterministic geometry for the V01-V25 mission-verifier fixtures.
_fixture.provenance: SYNTHETIC. Home is Komati Power Station; every other coordinate is generated from metre offsets so each verifier check has a provable edge. This is not a survey and never substitutes for site/site.json.
_fixture.frame: Local metres east/north of home, mapped with 111320 m/deg lat and 111320*cos(lat) m/deg lon - the planner site.ts projection.

landmarks.geofence notch: x 250..500, y -80..80 is CUT OUT of the geofence so a leg between two contained targets can still leave containment (V25).
landmarks.ash-dam: ceiling 30 m AGL - low enough that the band (20-80 m) contains both a legal overflight (V01 at 45 m) and an at-ceiling breach (V10/V11).
landmarks.chimney-stack: ceiling 80 m AGL - no legal overflight inside the band.
landmarks.boiler-house: clutter requiring healthy LiDAR below clear_altitude_m (V16).
